title:
Epic that validates the required fields of the specified formId and
displays an error banner if any required fields are missing.

Payload should receive the following values:
    stepIndex(i): The i-th step index to perform the form validation.
    formId: The id of the form step to validate within a multi-step form.
    requiredFields: An array of field ids that are required.
    componentId: The id of the multi-step form.
    updateToIndex: The index of the current step.
name: ValidateMultiStepFormFieldsEpic
